lede: AI for electricity utilities helps operations, engineering and asset teams scope practical pilots around grid decisions. Participants assess SCADA and asset-data readiness, rank use cases such as fault detection or renewable forecasting, and define human review and monitoring controls using CRISP-DM and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. Exercises produce bounded pilot plans with indicators and criteria for adjusting or stopping.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or support decisions about utility data, grid reliability, renewable integration and power-asset maintenance. It suits operational and digital teams who need to turn an AI proposal into a bounded, reviewable pilot.
modules: NIST AI RMF and Pilot Controls
prerequisites: Working familiarity with utility operations, power systems, renewable-energy operations, mini-grids, asset maintenance or energy-sector digital work is expected. No coding or programming is required; exercises focus on scoping, operational data checks and pilot decisions.
